title.narrative: Digital Transformation of Local Self-Governments in Montenegro

description.narrative: Digitalization serves as a catalyst for social and economic progress, an instrument for improving the quality of life for citizens, and a foundation for a more efficient, inclusive, and modern public administration. UNOPS and the government are working together to enhance local eGovernment Services in Montenegro. In collaboration with the Ministry of Public Administration, UNOPS conducts a comprehensive assessment of electronic administration in local government units. This assessment will provide solutions to plan and implement effective digital transformation strategies.
